## Task 1 · Two phones, two builds

The studio *Byte Bay* makes the puzzle game *Star Garden* for an Android
phone and for an iPhone.

a) Put the four layers of Android in order, from the bottom to the top:
*apps*, *Linux kernel*, *app framework*, *libraries*.

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

b) Which package does each build of *Star Garden* use (.apk or .ipa)? Can
the Android build be installed on the iPhone (yes / no)?

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

## Task 2 · A call in level 4

Lina plays level 4 of the racing game *Turbo Lane* on her Android phone
(4 GB RAM). A call arrives. After the call she opens eight other apps, and
then she taps the icon of the game again.

a) Put the states of the game in order, from the call until the game is
ended: *ended*, *foreground*, *background*.

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

b) What must the game do when the call arrives? Write **A**, **B** or
**C**. (A) pause and save level 4 (B) keep the race running (C) end at once

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

c) *Turbo Lane* asks for the contacts, and Lina answers "Don't allow". Can
the game still read her contacts (yes / no)?

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}
